# BaseTemplates

> > BaseTemplates provides comprehensive pitch deck, financial modeling, and fundraising templates plus investor databases and educational resources for startup founders.

BaseTemplates is a one-stop resource for startup founders seeking to raise capital, offering professionally designed templates in multiple formats (PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote, Notion, Figma), financial modeling tools, investor databases with 7000+ VCs and angels, and extensive educational content including courses, playbooks, and pitch deck examples.

## Key Topics

- Pitch Deck Template
- Startup Fundraising
- Financial Model Template
- Venture Capital
- Investor Database
- Notion Templates
- Google Slides
- PowerPoint
- Pitch Deck Examples
- Founder Resources
- Startup Funding
- Pitch Training
- Cap Table
- Fundraising Checklist
- Investor Pitch

## Core Templates & Products

- [Pitch Deck Template 2024](https://www.basetemplates.com/pitch-deck-template): Main pitch deck template available in PPT, Keynote, and Google Slides formats
- [Financial Model Template for Startups](https://www.basetemplates.com/financial-model-template): Financial modeling template for startups in Excel and Google Sheets
- [Notion Fundraising Template](https://www.basetemplates.com/notion-fundraising-template): Notion-based fundraising template with investor CRM and updates features
- [Figma Pitch Deck Template](https://www.basetemplates.com/figma-pitch-deck-template): Pitch deck template designed for Figma with modern, editable design
- [Notion Startup Templates Bundle](https://www.basetemplates.com/notion-startup-template-bundle): Bundle of 50+ Notion templates for marketing, sales, fundraising, and startup operations
- [Startup Fundraising Bundle](https://www.basetemplates.com/startup-fundraising-bundle): Bundle package combining pitch deck, financial model, and Notion templates with course content

## Investor Resources & Databases

- [Investor List for Startups](https://www.basetemplates.com/investor-list): Database of 7000+ startup investors filterable by geography, thesis, stage, and check size
- [Startup Investor Lists (VCs & Business Angels)](https://www.basetemplates.com/investors): Directory of VCs, angels, accelerators, and incubators organized by geographic location
- [200+ Real Pitch Deck Examples](https://www.basetemplates.com/pitch-deck-examples): Collection of 200+ pitch deck examples from successful startups and unicorn companies

## Educational Content & Courses

- [How to Fundraise and Build Your Pitch Deck - Course](https://www.basetemplates.com/how-to-fundraise-and-build-your-pitch-deck): Online course teaching fundraising and pitch deck creation from start to finish
- [Startup Academy - 200+ Videos for Founders](https://www.basetemplates.com/startup-school): Curated library of 200+ educational videos for founders on fundraising and startup strategy
- [Startup Playbooks](https://www.basetemplates.com/playbooks): Deep-dive guides on startup growth, marketing, AI tools, and founder strategies
- [Pitch Deck Slides Explained](https://www.basetemplates.com/pitch-deck-slides): How-to guide explaining each pitch deck slide with examples and templates
- [Investor Pitch Training](https://www.basetemplates.com/investor-pitch-training): Practice tool with 200+ real investor questions and explanations for pitch preparation

## Guides & Checklists

- [Startup Fundraising Checklist](https://www.basetemplates.com/startup-fundraising-checklist): 100+ step checklist covering preparation, investor outreach, and closing investment
- [Cap Table Template & Guide](https://www.basetemplates.com/cap-table-template): Guide explaining capitalization tables with free Google Sheets template for startups

## Professional Services

- [Custom Pitch Deck Design](https://www.basetemplates.com/custom-pitch-deck-design): Custom pitch deck design service with expert designers for startups
